title: Release quest-cli 0.7.0 (paired with lore 0.7.0)
description:
Bump quest-cli from 0.6.2 to 0.7.0, paired in lockstep with lore-cli 0.7.0 (both parked at 0.6.2 as of the pre-tag audit, OPAG-142). Landing the version bump on dev/main is ordinary delivery; the tag and the publish are separate, later, user-authorized steps -- this task covers the bump only.

Verified before starting: npm holds no 0.7.0 for any of the seven @opum-ai/quest* package names (checked live). Bun 1.3.14 matches package.jsons pinned packageManager.

File list, per docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md#what-a-version-bump-touches (written 2026-09-14 from a dedicated pre-tag audit) plus one gap that audit missed and this task found: .claude-plugin/plugin.json (0.6.0, unchanged since the 2026-09-10 recreation, stuck two releases behind the CLI it ships alongside -- QCLI-258 the 0.6.0 release task already listed it as a hand-edited site, and nothing enforces it, so it silently drifted through 0.6.1 and 0.6.2).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version bumped across every hand-edited location (package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture, .claude-plugin/plugin.json) and all six platform packages rebuilt via a CI dispatch of prepublication-qualification.yml against the release branch (not a local build-platform-packages.mjs run), with check:packages/test:packages both green, landed as dev-only prep -- no tag, no promotion beyond dev->main, no publish yet
bun.lock regenerated so its platform-package optionalDependencies pins match the new version (QCLI-292s subject, touched here regardless of that tasks own resolution)
CLAUDE.md managed Quest block regenerated against the freshly built local binary, not the globally installed CLI
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased heading moved to the new version with todays date, not before this bump actually lands
dev promoted to main via the standard fast-forward sequence once the bump PR is green

plan: 2. Bump the four independent hand-edited sources plus .claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.7.0, and hand-sync root optionalDependencies + each platform package.json .version field (text only, binaries untouched) so check:packages passes; commit
3. Push and dispatch prepublication-qualification.yml against the branch to build real platform binaries in CI (no local build-platform-packages.mjs run)
4. Download the six quest-package-<target> artifacts, replace npm/quest-<platform>/{package.json,bin/quest(.exe),LICENSE}, update root package.json questPlatformPackages checksums

5. Regenerate bun.lock via bun install; regenerate CLAUDE.md managed block against the freshly built local darwin-arm64 binary (execute before final delete-and-recreate per the SIGKILL hazard runbook section)
6. Move CHANGELOG.md Unreleased heading to 0.7.0 with todays date
7. bun run check && check:packages && test:packages all green; commit
8. PR into dev, wait for source-gates + Tracker integrity green, squash-merge
9. Promote dev to main via the standard fast-forward sequence
10. Report; do not tag or dispatch release.yml
